policy: After qualifying combat progress: 2 crowns per completed non-Ancient map point plus earned unspent gold at 25:1, then existing capped trait/Treasury multipliers. A non-abandoned combat death after a completed manual card play gets one participation point. Reached floors remain separate Chronicle data. Starting gold is excluded and earned gold is spent/lost first.
limits: Matrix wins lower enemy HP and grant fixture card/Energy; death uses native induced damage. They are controlled integration cases, not campaign balance samples.
Campaigns use natural map entry and paid actions without HP/gold/debug interventions; bounded at reached floor six or natural death. They are not full campaigns or win-rate estimates.
Physical Deck/Linux, Steam transport and full natural multiplayer campaigns are untested. Existing owner settlement guards and pure co-op checks pass.
Stages have distinct diagnostic DLLs; the second build only adds observation fields and campaign driver support. No publishing or release-package changes.
